summary: The source requires five-second dashboard auto-refresh while also requiring API calls to be minimized, creating an unresolved tension.

items.statement: The dashboard should auto-refresh every 5 seconds.

evidence.quote: The dashboard should auto-refresh every 5 seconds.

items.statement: Performance is critical and API calls should be minimized.

evidence.quote: Performance is critical, minimize API calls.

contradictions.description: Refreshing the dashboard every 5 seconds may increase API calls while API calls are required to be minimized.
contradictions.clarification_question: How should the five-second auto-refresh requirement and API-call minimization requirement be reconciled, and which takes precedence if both cannot be satisfied?

extractor_notes: The unresolved tension is preserved for stakeholder resolution; no refresh implementation is selected.
